summary: 16 scans available, of which mv, umv only move devices and record no data. Call bec_scan_help with a name for its arguments and an example.

scans.name: acquire
scans.description: A simple acquisition at the current position.

scans.name: cont_line_scan
scans.description: A continuous line scan. Use this scan if you want to move a motor continuously

scans.name: grid_scan
scans.description: Scan two or more motors in a grid.

scans.name: hexagonal_scan
scans.description: Scan two motors in a hexagonal grid pattern.

scans.name: line_scan
scans.description: A line scan for one or more motors.

scans.name: line_sweep_scan
scans.description: Read out monitored devices while a single device moves continuously from

scans.name: list_scan
scans.description: A scan following the positions specified in a list.

scans.name: log_scan
scans.description: A scan for one or more motors with logarithmically spaced positions.

scans.name: multi_region_grid_scan
scans.description: Scan two motors on multiple independent rectangular sub-grids.

scans.name: multi_region_line_scan
scans.description: Scan one motor across multiple disjoint line regions.

scans.name: mv
scans.description: Simple move command that moves one or more motors to the specified positions.

scans.name: round_roi_scan
scans.description: A scan following a round-roi-like pattern.

scans.name: round_scan
scans.description: A scan following a round shell-like pattern with increasing number of points in each ring. The scan starts at the inner ring and moves outwards.

scans.name: time_scan
scans.description: Trigger and readout devices at a fixed interval.

scans.name: umv
scans.description: Simple move command that moves one or more motors to the specified positions.
